accepted_sources.concise_video_summary: The creator presents 'The Box Strategy', a mean-reversion trading methodology based on drawing horizontal boundaries using the previous session's high and low prices (or previous daily high/low). The rules dictate avoiding buying at the top boundary, avoiding shorting at the bottom boundary, and refraining from trading inside the middle zone during early market open. Entries trigger when price tests the upper/lower boundary (or broken prior daily low converted to resistance) and forms a rejection candlestick pattern (e.g., doji or pinbar). Risk management relies on tight initial stops beyond the rejection high/low, trailing stops to break-even after initial movement, and targeting opposite boundaries or trailing until reversal.
